vsm1.4:67.2: yathā hi acheko madhukaro asukasmiṃ rukkhe pupphaṃ pupphitanti ñatvā
vsm1.4:67.6: Aparo acheko mandena javena pakkhando khīṇeyeva sampāpuṇāti.
vsm1.4:68.1: Yathā ca sallakattaantevāsikesu udakathālagate uppalapatte satthakammaṃ sikkhantesu
vsm1.4:68.7: Cheko pana samena payogena tattha satthapahāraṃ dassetvā
vsm1.4:68.9: tathārūpesu ṭhānesu kammaṃ katvā lābhaṃ labhati.
vsm1.4:69.1: Yathā ca yo catubyāmappamāṇaṃ makkaṭasuttamāharati, so cattāri sahassāni labhatīti raññā vutte
vsm1.4:69.2: eko achekapuriso vegena makkaṭasuttamākaḍḍhanto tahiṃ tahiṃ chindatiyeva.
vsm1.4:69.3: Aparo acheko chedanabhayā hatthena phusitumpi na visahati.
vsm1.4:69.4: Cheko pana koṭito paṭṭhāya samena payogena daṇḍake vedhetvā āharitvā lābhaṃ labhati.
vsm1.4:70.1: Yathā ca acheko niyāmako balavavāte laṅkāraṃ pūrento nāvaṃ videsaṃ pakkhandāpeti.
vsm1.4:70.2: Aparo acheko mandavāte laṅkāraṃ oropento nāvaṃ tattheva ṭhapeti.
vsm1.4:71.1: Yathā ca yo telena achaḍḍento nāḷiṃ pūreti, so lābhaṃ labhatīti ācariyena antevāsikānaṃ vutte
vsm1.4:71.2: eko acheko lābhaluddho vegena pūrento telaṃ chaḍḍeti.
vsm1.4:71.3: Aparo acheko telachaḍḍanabhayā āsiñcitumpi na visahati.
vsm1.4:71.4: Cheko pana samena payogena pūretvā lābhaṃ labhati.
vsm1.4:72.2: sīghameva appanaṃ pāpuṇissāmīti gāḷhaṃ vīriyaṃ karoti,
vsm1.4:72.3: tassa cittaṃ accāraddhavīriyattā uddhacce patati, so na sakkoti appanaṃ pāpuṇituṃ.
vsm1.4:72.4: Eko accāraddhavīriyatāya dosaṃ disvā kiṃ dānime appanāyāti vīriyaṃ hāpeti,
vsm1.4:72.5: tassa cittaṃ atilīnavīriyattā kosajje patati, sopi na sakkoti appanaṃ pāpuṇituṃ.
vsm1.4:73.2:
Reṇumhi uppaladale, sutte nāvāya nāḷiyā;
Yathā madhukarādīnaṃ, pavatti sammavaṇṇitā.
vsm1.4:73.3:
Līnauddhatabhāvehi, mocayitvāna sabbaso;
Evaṃ nimittābhimukhaṃ, mānasaṃ paṭipādaye
vsm1.4:74.1: Iti evaṃ nimittābhimukhaṃ mānasaṃ paṭipādayato panassa
vsm1.4:74.3: bhavaṅgaṃ upacchinditvā pathavī pathavīti anuyogavasena upaṭṭhitaṃ tadeva pathavīkasiṇaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā manodvārāvajjanamuppajjati.
vsm1.4:74.4: Tato tasmiṃyevārammaṇe cattāri pañca vā javanāni javanti.
vsm1.4:74.5: Tesu avasāne ekaṃ rūpāvacaraṃ, sesāni kāmāvacarāni.
vsm1.4:74.6: Pakaticittehi balavataravitakkavicārapītisukhacittekaggatāni yāni appanāya parikammattā parikammānītipi, yathā gāmādīnaṃ āsannapadeso gāmūpacāro nagarūpacāroti vuccati, evaṃ appanāya āsannattā samīpacārattā vā upacārānītipi, ito pubbe parikammānaṃ, upari appanāya ca anulomato anulomānītipi vuccanti.
vsm1.4:76.1: Ābhidhammikagodattatthero pana ‘‘purimā purimā kusalā dhammā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo’’ti (paṭṭhā. 1.1.12)
vsm1.4:76.2: imaṃ suttaṃ vatvā āsevanapaccayena pacchimo pacchimo dhammo balavā hoti, tasmā chaṭṭhepi sattamepi appanā hotīti āha.
vsm1.4:77.1: Taṃ aṭṭhakathāsu ‘‘attano matimattaṃ therasseta’’nti vatvā paṭikkhittaṃ.
vsm1.4:77.3: Parato javanaṃ patitaṃ nāma hoti, bhavaṅgassa āsannattāti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:77.4: Tameva vicāretvā vuttattā na sakkā paṭikkhipituṃ.
vsm1.4:77.5: Yathā hi puriso chinnapapātābhimukho dhāvanto ṭhātukāmopi pariyante pādaṃ katvā ṭhātuṃ na sakkoti papāte eva patati,
vsm1.4:77.6: evaṃ chaṭṭhe vā sattame vā appetuṃ na sakkoti, bhavaṅgassa āsannattā.
vsm1.4:78.2: Sattasu hi ṭhānesu addhānaparicchedo nāma natthi
vsm1.4:78.10: Ettha maggānantaraphalaṃ tiṇṇaṃ upari na hoti.
vsm1.4:79.1: Ettāvatā ca panesa vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi
vsm1.4:79.2: savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati (dha. sa. 160; dī. ni. 1.226).
vsm1.4:79.4: tividhakalyāṇaṃ dasalakkhaṇasampannaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ adhigataṃ hoti pathavīkasiṇaṃ.
vsm1.4:80.4: Yo panāyamettha evakāro, so niyamatthoti veditabbo.
vsm1.4:80.5: Yasmā ca niyamattho, tasmā tasmiṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharaṇasamaye
vsm1.4:81.1: ‘‘Vivicceva kāmehī’’ti evañhi niyame kariyamāne idaṃ paññāyati,
vsm1.4:81.2: nūna jhānassa kāmā paṭipakkhabhūtā yesu sati idaṃ nappavattati,
vsm1.4:81.4: Tesaṃ pariccāgeneva cassa adhigamo hoti, orimatīrapariccāgena pārimatīrasseva.
vsm1.4:82.1: Tattha siyā, kasmā panesa pubbapadeyeva vutto, na uttarapade,
vsm1.4:82.2: kiṃ akusalehi dhammehi aviviccāpi jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyāti?
vsm1.4:82.5: Kāmadhātusamatikkamanato hi kāmarāgapaṭipakkhato ca idaṃ jhānaṃ kāmānameva nissaraṇaṃ.
vsm1.4:82.7: Uttarapadepi pana yathā ‘‘idheva, bhikkhave, samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo’’ti (ma. ni. 1.139; a. ni. 4.241) ettha evakāro ānetvā vuccati, evaṃ vattabbo.
vsm1.4:82.8: Na hi sakkā ito aññehipi nīvaraṇasaṅkhātehi akusaladhammehi avivicca jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
vsm1.4:82.9: Tasmā ‘‘vivicceva kāmehi vivicceva akusalehi dhammehī’’ti evaṃ padadvayepi esa daṭṭhabbo.
vsm1.4:82.10: Padadvayepi ca kiñcāpi viviccāti iminā sādhāraṇavacanena
vsm1.4:82.11: tadaṅgavivekādayo, kāyavivekādayo ca sabbepi vivekā saṅgahaṃ gacchanti,
vsm1.4:82.12: tathāpi kāyaviveko cittaviveko vikkhambhanavivekoti tayo eva idha daṭṭhabbā.
vsm1.4:83.1: Kāmehīti iminā pana padena ye ca niddese ‘‘katame vatthukāmā, manāpiyā rūpā’’tiādinā (mahāni. 1) nayena vatthukāmā vuttā,
vsm1.4:83.2: ye ca tattheva vibhaṅge ca ‘‘chando kāmo, rāgo kāmo, chandarāgo kāmo, saṅkappo kāmo, rāgo kāmo, saṅkapparāgo kāmo, ime vuccanti kāmā’’ti (mahāni. 1; vibha. 564) evaṃ kilesakāmā vuttā, te sabbepi saṅgahitāicceva daṭṭhabbā.
vsm1.4:83.3: Evañhi sati vivicceva kāmehīti vatthukāmehipi viviccevāti attho yujjati,
vsm1.4:83.5: Vivicca akusalehi dhammehīti kilesakāmehi sabbākusalehi vā viviccāti attho yujjati,
vsm1.4:83.7: Purimena cettha vatthukāmehi vivekavacanato eva kāmasukhapariccāgo,
vsm1.4:83.8: dutiyena kilesakāmehi vivekavacanato nekkhammasukhapariggaho vibhāvito hoti.
vsm1.4:84.1: Evaṃ vatthukāmakilesakāmavivekavacanatoyeva ca etesaṃ paṭhamena saṃkilesavatthuppahānaṃ,
vsm1.4:84.5: Paṭhamena ca payogasuddhi, dutiyena āsayaposanaṃ vibhāvitaṃ hotīti viññātabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:84.6: Esa tāva nayo kāmehīti ettha vuttakāmesu vatthukāmapakkhe.
vsm1.4:85.1: Kilesakāmapakkhe pana chandoti ca rāgoti ca evamādīhi anekabhedo
vsm1.4:85.4: ‘‘tattha katamo kāmo chando kāmo’’tiādinā (vibha. 564) nayena vibhaṅge jhānapaṭipakkhato visuṃ vutto.
vsm1.4:85.7: Anekabhedato cassa kāmatoti avatvā kāmehīti vuttaṃ.
vsm1.4:86.2: ‘‘tattha katame akusalā dhammā, kāmacchando’’tiādinā nayena vibhaṅge upari jhānaṅgānaṃ paccanīkapaṭipakkhabhāvadassanato nīvaraṇāneva vuttāni.
vsm1.4:86.4: tesaṃ jhānaṅgāneva paṭipakkhāni viddhaṃsakāni vighātakānīti vuttaṃ hoti.
